data.title: A2 · 清晨的热饮
data.description: 晨光穿过避难所破损的百叶窗。A2 穿着宽松衬衫坐在床边，低头吹凉手里的热饮。
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of a simple cot in an abandoned bunker, A2 holds a battered metal mug in both hands, blowing gently across the surface of a hot drink. Morning sunlight filters through cracked metal blinds, casting clear slashes of light across the concrete room.
data.animaCaption: She waits for the drink to cool.
